name: Gasthof Christophorus
beschreibung: The Gasthof Christophorus is located in Söll in the Tyrolean Unterland. The property offers rooms in a traditional guest house. The room amenities are functional and comfortable. The in-house restaurant serves hearty Tyrolean specialities. The surrounding landscape features lush meadows and serene woodlands. Scenic walking trails begin right outside the front door. The cable cars of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental are within comfortable walking distance. The inn is well suited for guests seeking a peaceful and relaxing getaway.
